title: Frost Hollow
author: Ingrid Vasko
description: A snowbound cabin, a dying radio, and a storm that doesn't care if you make it out.

sections.text: You wake up in a snowbound cabin, a dead radio crackling on the shelf.
The radio sparks to life with a distress beacon location.
The storm is fierce. Ice cuts at your exposed skin as you stumble forward.
Your body is shutting down from the cold, but you spot a faint light ahead.

consequence.text: The last of your strength gives out as the cold overwhelms you.

sections.text: The coordinates lead you to a hidden supply cache.

options.description: Take the flare gun and signal for help

sections.text: Back in the cabin, you find a locked trunk but you have no tool to pry it open. Exhausted, you settle in and wait.
You collapse in the snow, the cabin lights fading from view.
A rescue helicopter spots your flare. You're saved!
